items.stem: How many centimetres make up one metre?
Which of the following is not a way to measure length according to the passage?

The length of the boundary of an object or shape is called perimeter. If a shape has a perimeter of 20 cm, how many different shapes can be drawn with this perimeter?

If a student's height is 1.5 metres, what is this in centimetres?
